name: context-mode
description: Keeps raw tool output out of coding agents' context by running code and commands in a sandbox, indexing results for search, and restoring session state after compaction, via MCP.

skills.name: Sandboxed Execution
skills.description: Runs code in 12 languages or processes files in an isolated subprocess with ctx_execute, letting only stdout enter the agent's context.

skills.name: Indexed Knowledge Base
skills.description: Chunks markdown or fetched URLs into a SQLite FTS5 index with ctx_index and ctx_fetch_and_index, then returns snippets via ctx_search.

skills.name: Session Continuity
skills.description: Tracks file edits, git operations, tasks, errors, and decisions in SQLite, and rebuilds working state after compaction or resume.

skills.name: Batch Execution
skills.description: Runs several commands and search queries in one ctx_batch_execute call, with optional concurrency for I/O-bound batches.
